hardware: Intel Arc A77016GB; Xeon E5-2696v4;256GiB DDR3;Windows10
baseline: Retained cross-layer ESIMD GDN commit,36 independent layers,4/6-slot capacities,all positive acceptance counts.
method: One screening process per variant; shape-local A/B/A/B/A within the same kernel object. Each phase resets and checks the full state;3x64 warmup sequences then9x128 timed sequences,wait at each batch end. Fixed host affinity and priority. Values are microseconds per36-layer sequence.
gate: All shape reductions must exceed3% to advance to two further processes; confirmation requires conservative stage reduction>3%. None advanced. Screening observations are not confirmed speedups.
correctness: 71 checks per variant: bitwise baseline state,CPU history,partial/nonzero global and local layer offsets,guards,read-only inputs,dynamic graph replay and unsupported-call refusal.
